blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
LLM agents with tool-calling capabilities can access external services and private user data, but they may retrieve more information than a user’s request explicitly requires.
We study this behavior in structured tool-calling agents and term it proactive over-authorization .
This setting differs from filesystem-level coding agents because the main risk is unnecessary access to private data.
We introduce OverAct , a controlled benchmark spanning eight privacy-sensitive domains with deterministic, judge-free scoring, together with an interpretive decision-theoretic framework that yields three testable predictions.
Across seven models from four families, all models significantly exceed authorized scope.
Request specificity is the strongest predictor of severity, over-authorization grows sublinearly with tool-pool size, and decoding temperature has little effect.
These patterns are consistent with a cost-asymmetry account, suggesting that over-authorization arises more from structural decision tendencies than from decoding randomness.
We also propose SelfAudit , a zero-shot inference-time method that generates request-grounded justifications and filters unjustified calls before execution.
Ablation shows that explicit filtering is the main driver of scope reduction. SelfAudit reduces privacy-oriented excess by 43% without oracle knowledge.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
LLM-based agents increasingly interact with external services through structured tool calls ( Schick et al., 2023 ; Qin et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2023 ) .
Recent surveys document the rapid growth of these systems and the privacy and security concerns they raise ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2025 ; Das et al., 2025 ) .
In this setting, a user issues a natural-language request and the agent autonomously decides which APIs to invoke, creating a failure mode: the agent may access data beyond what the request explicitly requires.
Consider a user asking a banking agent to “ check my balance ”.
Under a conservative interpretation, the minimally sufficient response is a single get_checking_balance call.
In practice, however, an agent may also retrieve transaction history, savings details, or card information, each exposing personal data not strictly required by the request.
Similarly, in healthcare, asking “ When is my next appointment? ” may trigger retrieval of medication lists, lab results, or diagnosis history, creating tension with data-minimization principles ( Goldsteen et al., 2022 ) .
We study this behavior as proactive over-authorization , defined as expansion of the agent’s action scope beyond what the user’s words explicitly entail.
Unlike generic tool overuse, the main concern here is unnecessary access to private data.
blocks.zh:
基于LLM的代理商通过结构化的工具调用与外部服务日益互动(Schick等人,2023年;秦等人,2024年;姚等人,2023年).
最近的调查记录了这些系统的迅速发展及其引起的隐私和安全问题(秦等人,2025年;习近平等人,2025年;达斯等人,2025年)。
在这个设置中,用户会发出一个自然语言请求,代理商会自主决定哪些API可以引用,从而形成一个失败模式:代理商可以访问请求明确要求以外的数据.
考虑一个用户要求银行代理人“检查我的余额”。
在保守的解释下,最低程度的足够反应是单次获得_检查_平衡呼叫.
但在实践中,代理人还可以检索交易历史、储蓄细节或卡片信息,每张卡片都披露请求中不严格要求的个人数据。
同样,在保健方面,问“我的下次预约是什么时候?” 可能会引发药物清单、化验结果或诊断史的检索,造成与数据最小化原则的矛盾(Goldsteen等人,2022年)。
我们研究这种行为是主动的过度授权,定义是将代理人的行动范围扩大,超出使用者的言语明确要求的范围。
与通用工具过度使用不同,这里的主要关切是不必要的获取私人数据.

blocks.en:
Existing agent safety benchmarks focus mainly on catastrophic or adversarial failures, such as jailbreaking ( Wei et al., 2023 ) , prompt injection ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , and malicious misuse ( Ye et al., 2024 ) ; recent work also evaluates broader forms of agentic harmfulness ( Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) .
Tool-calling benchmarks, by contrast, primarily measure task success and tool-use correctness without penalizing excess retrieval scope ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Mialon et al., 2024 ) , although recent work has begun to examine unnecessary or overeager tool use ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
Concurrent work studies a related phenomenon in filesystem-level coding agents, where agents perform out-of-scope actions on benign tasks ( Qu et al., 2026 ) .
We focus on the complementary setting of structured tool-calling APIs that access private user data.
Our question is different from prior work: not whether an agent can use the right tools, but whether it can avoid plausible but unnecessary ones when those tools expose private data.
blocks.zh:
现有特工安全基准主要侧重于灾难性或对抗性失误,如越狱(Wei等人,2023年),即时注射(Zhan等人,2024年)和恶意滥用(Ye等人,2024年);近期的工作还评价了更广泛的毒害形式(Andriushchenko等人,2025年)。
相比之下,工具调用基准主要衡量任务的成功和工具使用的正确性,而不惩罚过多的检索范围(Patil等人,2025年;Mialon等人,2024年),尽管最近的工作已开始审查不必要的或过度使用工具的情况(徐等人,2025年;Zeng等人,2026年)。
同时期工作研究了文件系统一级编码代理中的一种相关现象,即代理在良性任务上进行范围外的行动(Qu等人,2026年).
我们的重点是对获取私人用户数据的结构化工具调用API的补充设置。
我们的问题与以前的工作不同:不是代理人能否使用正确的工具,而是当这些工具暴露私人数据时,它是否能够避免可能但不必要的工具。

blocks.en:
To study this question, we introduce OverAct , a controlled benchmark of 720 episodes spanning eight privacy-sensitive domains, each annotated with a benchmark reference minimal tool set. OverAct supports deterministic, judge-free evaluation: over-authorization is measured by comparing the tools an agent actually calls with the tools minimally required, without any LLM-based scoring.
This setup adopts a deliberately conservative benchmark criterion, enabling reproducible and privacy-protective measurement of scope expansion.
It is useful to distinguish three notions of scope. Benchmark-authorized scope is the set of tools entailed by the user’s literal words under our conservative policy. User-preferred scope is what a given user would actually want. Deployment-safe scope is what a production policy or compliance regime permits.
Our empirical claims are anchored to benchmark-authorized scope; the other two notions provide important context, but we do not claim that benchmark excess always corresponds to user dispreference or deployment harm.
blocks.zh:
为了研究这个问题,我们引入了OverAct(Official Act),一个720集的可控基准,涵盖8个对隐私敏感的领域,每集附加一个基准参考最小工具集. OverAct支持确定性,无法官评价:通过比较代理实际调用的工具与最低要求的工具,而不是基于LLM的评分来衡量过度授权.
这种设置采用了一种有意保守的基准标准,从而能够对扩展范围进行可复制和保护隐私的衡量。
区分三个范围概念是有益的。 基准授权范围是用户在保守政策下用文字表达的一套工具。 用户首选范围是给定用户实际想要的. 部署安全是生产政策或遵守制度允许的。
我们的经验性主张以基准授权的范围为基础;另外两个概念提供了重要的背景,但我们并不声称基准超额总是与用户的偏爱或部署损害相对应。

blocks.en:
We develop an interpretive decision-theoretic account of tool selection.
Its core intuition is that asymmetric omission and commission costs induce a low effective inclusion threshold, making semantically related but unnecessary tools more likely to be called.
This account yields three qualitative predictions: over-authorization should increase as requests become less specific, grow sublinearly with tool availability, and remain relatively stable across decoding temperatures.
We test these predictions across seven models from four families in more than 90,000 core experimental runs, and find that over-authorization is widespread and broadly consistent with these regularities.

我们开发一个解释性的决定理论 工具选择。
其核心直觉是,不对称的遗漏和佣金成本会导致低有效包容阈值,从而使得集合相关但不必要的工具更容易被调用.
该账户得出三个定性预测:过多授权应随着请求的更具体化而增加,随着工具的可用性而分线增长,并在解码温度方面保持相对稳定。
我们在9万多个核心实验中测试了来自4个家庭的7个模型的这些预测,发现过度授权是普遍和与这些规律大体一致的.

blocks.en:
We also compare five prompt-level interventions.
Among them, only exact permission lists serve as an oracle upper bound, substantially reducing scope without lowering task completion.
We therefore explore SelfAudit , an inference-time method that generates request-grounded justifications for planned tool calls and filters unjustified actions before execution.
Ablation shows that explicit filtering, rather than structured justification alone, drives most of the reduction.
Overall, our contributions are as follows: 1. We define proactive over-authorization under a conservative privacy-first benchmark criterion and present an interpretive cost-asymmetry account that organizes three empirical regularities into testable predictions. 2. We introduce OverAct , a controlled evaluation protocol with judge-free scoring across eight privacy-sensitive API domains. 3. We provide large-scale evidence that over-authorization is widespread, evaluate prompt-level interventions, and present SelfAudit , an oracle-free proof of concept showing that explicit self-filtering, rather than structured reasoning alone, drives scope reduction.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our work relates to three lines of research: tool-calling evaluation, agent safety and privacy, and alignment dynamics.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作涉及三条研究线:工具调用评价、代理安全和隐私以及协调动态。

blocks.en:
Tool-calling agents and evaluation. LLMs are increasingly deployed as tool-calling agents ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , with representative frameworks including Toolformer ( Schick et al., 2023 ) , ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , and ToolLLM ( Qin et al., 2024 ) .
Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate task success or tool-use correctness, including AgentBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , BFCL ( Patil et al., 2025 ) , GAIA ( Mialon et al., 2024 ) , and ToolTalk ( Farn and Shin, 2023 ) .
Recent work has also studied unnecessary tool use, including training-time reward shaping for efficient tool calling ( Xu et al., 2025 ) and agents’ tendency to prefer external tools over internal knowledge ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) .
Recent efforts to build smaller agentic models through synthetic environments ( Lyu et al., 2026b ) and student-centered distillation ( Lyu et al., 2026a ) complement this line by improving tool-use capabilities at lower cost, while multi-agent reasoning frameworks ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) study how agent collaboration shapes tool selection.
Our focus is narrower and complementary: we study scope excess among otherwise plausible tool calls, where the concern is unnecessary access to private data.
Whereas prior work mainly asks whether a tool call is needed at all, we ask which additional tools are called beyond the minimal sufficient set.
blocks.zh:
工具调用代理和评价。 有限责任公司越来越多地作为工具调用剂部署(习近平等人,2025年;王等人,2024年;秦等人,2025年),具有代表性的框架包括Tolformer(Schick等人,2023年),ReAct(姚等人,2023年)和TolLLM(秦等人,2024年)。
现有基准主要评价任务成功或工具使用正确性,包括Bench代理(Liu等人,2024年),BFCL(Patil等人,2025年),GAIA(Mialon等人,2024年)和TolTalk(Farn and Shin,2023年).
最近的工作还研究了不必要的工具使用,包括培训时间奖励为高效工具调用(徐等人,2025年)和代理商偏爱外部工具而不是内部知识的倾向(曾等人,2026年).
近期通过合成环境(Lyu等人,2026年b)和以学生为中心的蒸馏(Lyu等人,2026年a)来构建较小的代理模型,通过以较低成本提高工具使用能力来补充这一线,而多代理推理框架(Zhang等人,2025年)则研究代理协作如何塑造工具选择.
我们的侧重点比较狭窄,相辅相成:我们研究在不必要地获取私人数据的情况下,在其他可能使用的工具呼吁中过于宽泛。
先前的工作主要询问是否还需要一个工具呼叫,而我们则询问,除了最低限度的足够工具外,还有哪些工具需要呼叫。

blocks.en:
Agent safety, privacy, and trustworthiness. Agent safety work has largely focused on catastrophic or adversarial failures, such as jailbreaking ( Wei et al., 2023 ) , prompt injection ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , and malicious misuse ( Ye et al., 2024 ) .
Related benchmarks include Agent-SafetyBench ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , ToolEmu ( Ruan et al., 2024 ) , R-Judge ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) , and AgentHarm ( Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) .
Broader work studies trustworthiness and privacy more generally, including training-data extraction ( Carlini et al., 2021 ) , data minimization ( Goldsteen et al., 2022 ) , text sanitization ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Awon et al., 2025 ) , and comprehensive surveys of generative-model trustworthiness ( Fan et al., 2025 ) .
Agent resilience against transient failures has also been studied in multi-agent settings ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , which is complementary to our focus on scope expansion rather than agent failure.
A related systems line enforces least-privilege constraints through external mechanisms such as programmable privilege-control policies ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , prompt-flow integrity checks ( Kim et al., 2025 ) , and formal access-control frameworks ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
These methods assume a pre-specified permission boundary and enforce it at the system level.
By contrast, OverAct is diagnostic: it measures the tendency toward scope expansion when no external constraint is imposed. Concurrent with our work, Qu et al. (2026) introduce OverEager-Gen, a benchmark for out-of-scope actions by filesystem-level coding agents on benign tasks.
The settings are complementary.
They study coding agents acting over filesystems, whereas we study structured API tool calls that access private user data.
We also focus on benchmark-defined minimal scope, an interpretive cost-asymmetry account, and an oracle-free inference-time mitigation.
blocks.zh:
特工的安全 隐私和可信赖性 特工安全工作主要集中于灾难性或对抗性的失误,如越狱(Wei等人,2023年),即时注射(Zhan等人,2024年),以及恶意滥用(Ye等人,2024年).
相关基准包括: Agent-Safety Bench(张等人,2024年),TolleEmu(Ruan等人,2024年),R法官 (袁等人,2024年),与哈姆特工(安德里乌先科等人,2025年).
更广义的工作研究可信赖性和隐私,包括培训数据提取(Carlini等人,2021年),数据最小化(Goldsteen等人,2022年),文本消毒(Chen等人,2023年;Awon等人,2025年),以及基因模型可信赖性综合调查(Fan等人,2025年).
在多剂环境下也研究了代理抗瞬间故障的能力(张等人,2026年),这补充了我们注重扩展范围而非代理故障.
一个相关的系统线通过可编程的特权控制政策(Shi等人,2025年),即时流量完整性检查(Kim等人,2025年),以及正式的准入控制框架(Li等人,2025年)等外部机制,强制执行最低特权限制。
这些方法假设预先指定的许可边界,并在系统层面执行.
相反,OverAct是诊断性的:它衡量在没有施加外部限制的情况下扩大范围的趋势。 与我们的工作同时,Qu等人(2026年)引入了OverEager-Gen,这是文件系统一级编码员在良性任务上进行范围外行动的基准.
这些设置是相辅相成的。
他们研究在文件系统上操作的编码代理, 而我们研究结构化的 API 工具调用私人用户数据。
我们还侧重于基准界定的最小范围、解释性成本-不对称账户和无甲骨文推断时间的缓解。

blocks.en:
Alignment dynamics and interpretive models. Preference-alignment methods such as RLHF ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Stiennon et al., 2020 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) and related optimization approaches ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) are central to modern LLM behavior ( Bai et al., 2022 ) .
Recent work studies unintended effects of these training regimes, including sycophancy ( Sharma et al., 2024 ; Shapira et al., 2026 ) , reward tampering, and other misalignment behaviors ( Denison et al., 2024 ; Perez et al., 2023 ) .
Our framing is related in spirit: proactive over-authorization can be viewed as an action-level form of over-helpfulness expressed through tool selection rather than text.
Formal analyses of reward misspecification and Goodhart effects ( Pan et al., 2022 ; Gao et al., 2023 ) further motivate this perspective.
We use a lightweight interpretive decision-theoretic account to organize empirical regularities rather than to claim a verified causal mechanism ( Russell and Norvig, 2020 ) .

blocks.en: 3 Decision-Theoretic Framework
blocks.zh: 3. 决定-理论框架

blocks.en:
This section presents an explanatory abstraction rather than a validated causal account of internal model computation.
We formalize tool selection as a cost-sensitive decision problem, derive an inclusion threshold from asymmetric error costs, and use it to motivate three testable predictions.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍内部模型计算的解释性抽象而不是经过验证的因果关系。
我们正式确定工具选择是一个对成本敏感的决策问题,从不对称错误成本中得出一个包含阈值,并利用它来激励三个可测试的预测.

If multiple sets of equal cardinality satisfy the request, we select the one that accesses fewer personally identifiable information (PII) categories, following a privacy-first tiebreaking rule (Appendix B.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Metrics

blocks.en:
We use three metrics to quantify the amount and severity of over-authorization. Scope Inflation Ratio (SIR) is SIR = | A actual | | A minimal | . \text{SIR}=\frac{|A_{\text{actual}}|}{|A_{\text{minimal}}|}. It measures excess scope as a multiplicative factor.
SIR = 1.0 =1.0 means the agent called exactly as many tools as the minimal set; it does not by itself indicate perfect compliance, because a set of the same cardinality may omit a required tool while including an unnecessary one. We therefore read SIR together with the Task Completion Rate (TCR), which detects omitted required tools, and additionally report exact-set match and normalized excess as complementary metrics in Appendix B.3 . SIR = 3.0 =3.0 means the agent called three times as many tools as needed.
Because many episodes have | A minimal | = 1 |A_{\text{minimal}}|=1 , ratio values can be magnified; we also report absolute excess counts and the Privacy Violation Score (PVS) in Appendix B.3 , which support the same qualitative conclusions. TCR is TCR = | A actual ∩ A minimal | | A minimal | . \text{TCR}=\frac{|A_{\text{actual}}\cap A_{\text{minimal}}|}{|A_{\text{minimal}}|}. Despite its name, TCR measures recall of the annotated minimal tool set: it does not check argument correctness, execution success, or whether the returned information actually satisfies the request. We therefore interpret it as a minimal-tool recall proxy for task completion; genuine end-to-end task-completion evaluation with executed tool outputs is a natural extension. TCR separates scope reduction from task failure: an agent that omits required tools scores low on TCR regardless of how many excess tools it calls. PVS is PVS = ∑ a ∈ A excess | PII ​ ( a ) | . \text{PVS}=\sum_{a\in A_{\text{excess}}}|\text{PII}(a)|. PVS is a benchmark-level severity proxy.
It sums the PII categories accessed by excess tool calls, counting duplicate categories across separate calls separately, so it captures cumulative privacy-oriented excess beyond raw excess count.
Further metric considerations are discussed in Appendix B.3 .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate seven models from four families: Qwen3.6 (Qwen3.6-Flash, Qwen3.6-Plus, Qwen3.7-Max) ( Team, 2025b ) , DeepSeek (v3 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2024 ) , v4-Pro ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) ), GLM-5.2 ( Zeng et al., 2024 ) , and Kimi-K2.7-Code ( Team, 2025a ) .
All models receive the same tool schemas and prompt templates, and we run three repetitions per configuration.
This yields 90,720 core runs (7 models × \times 6 conditions × \times 720 episodes × \times 3 repetitions), including 15,120 baseline runs, plus roughly 39,000 supplementary runs for temperature ablation, tool-pool scaling, permission granularity, SelfAudit , and reasoning-trace analysis, for about 130,000 runs in total.
Additional details are provided in Appendix C .
We compare five prompt-level interventions: Permission List , Explicit Scope , Minimization , Intent Echo , and Clarification .
Prompt templates are listed in Appendix C.1 .
We ask four questions: whether over-authorization appears consistently across models (RQ1), how it varies with request specificity (RQ2), which interventions reduce excess without large TCR losses (RQ3), and whether SelfAudit provides an effective zero-shot, oracle-free mitigation (RQ4).
These questions map directly onto the predictions of § 3.2 : RQ1 establishes the baseline phenomenon that the cost-asymmetry account is meant to explain; RQ2 tests Prediction 2 (specificity–excess monotonicity); the supporting analyses in § 4.4 test Prediction 3 (tool-pool saturation) and Prediction 4 (temperature invariance); and RQ3–RQ4 evaluate mitigation. The paper therefore proceeds from mechanism (§ 3.2 ) to measurement (§ 3.4 ) to falsification (RQ1–RQ2 and the supporting predictions) to mitigation (RQ3–RQ4).

blocks.en: 4.3 Specificity Gradient (RQ2, P2)
blocks.zh: 4.3 特性梯度(RQ2,P2)

blocks.en:
Specificity is the strongest predictor of over-authorization severity (Figure 2 ).
This is a controlled manipulation rather than a post hoc label: the three paraphrased versions of each episode share the same benchmark reference minimal tool set, so the observed gradient reflects how request wording modulates the same underlying scope requirement.
Precise requests yield near-perfect compliance, while even moderate ambiguity produces substantial inflation; vague requests produce 2.7 × 2.7\times scope excess ( d = 1.19 d=1.19 ).
This pattern is consistent with the threshold account: as request specificity decreases, more tools attain non-trivial relevance and cross the inclusion threshold.
The gradient appears for all models, although its steepness varies, and all pairwise specificity contrasts are significant.

精确请求几乎得到完全遵守,而即使是中等程度的模糊性也会导致大幅通货膨胀;模糊请求产生2.7×2.7\时的超出范围(d=1.19 d=1.19)。
这种模式与阈值账户一致:随着请求的特异性降低,更多的工具实现非三角关联性,并跨越纳入阈值.
所有模型都出现了梯度,尽管其陡度不同,所有对偶的特异性对比都很大.

blocks.en: Figure 2: SIR by model and request specificity. All models show near-perfect compliance for precise requests but substantial inflation for vague requests.
blocks.zh: 图2:按型号和要求的SIR。 所有模型都显示,精确请求几乎完全符合要求,而模糊请求则大幅通胀。

blocks.en: 4.4 Supporting Predictions (P3–P4)
blocks.zh: 4.4 支助预测(P3-P4)

blocks.en:
Tool-pool saturation (P3). To test whether tool availability modulates over-authorization, we vary the number of available tools across six pool sizes ( | 𝒜 | ∈ { 4 , 6 , 12 , 24 , 36 , 48 } |\mathcal{A}|\in\{4,6,12,24,36,48\} ) while holding queries fixed.
Figure 3 shows that SIR rises with pool size but saturates: growth is sublinear from 4 to 24 tools, then plateaus at larger pools.
At 36 and 48 tools, SIR is not meaningfully higher than at 24 (pool 36: 2.00 2.00 vs. pool 24: 1.97 1.97 ), indicating a clear ceiling under our setup.
This pattern is consistent with Prediction 3 ; additional analysis appears in Appendices D.1 and D.2 .
blocks.zh:
工具池饱和度(P3). 为了测试工具可用性是否调制过量授权,我们在6个集合大小(QQ A QQ { { 4, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48}} QQmathcal{ A}|\in {4, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48})的可用工具数量不同,同时持有查询固定.
图3显示,SIR随池大小但饱和度上升:生长为4至24个工具的亚线性,然后在更大的池中高原.
在36和48个工具上,SIR没有比24个工具有意义地高(集合36:2.00 2.00对集合24:1.97 1.97),表明我们的设置下有一个明确的上限.
这一模式与预测3是一致的;附加分析载于附录D.1和D.2。

blocks.en: Figure 3: SIR as a function of tool-pool size. Over-authorization grows sublinearly from 4 to 24 tools, then plateaus at 36–48, consistent with P3.
blocks.zh: 图3:SIR作为工具库大小的函数. 过度授权从4个工具到24个工具子线性增长,然后高原在36–48,与P3一致.

blocks.en:
Temperature invariance (P4). We test whether over-authorization is primarily a sampling artifact by running identical episodes at three temperature settings (0.0, 0.7, 1.0).
SIR is statistically indistinguishable across conditions ( p = 0.367 p=0.367 ), consistent with Prediction 4 .
Under our setup, over-authorization appears to depend more on model and input than on decoding stochasticity, suggesting that lowering temperature alone is unlikely to eliminate it.
blocks.zh:
温度变化(P4). 我们通过在三个温度环境(0.0、0.7、1.0)下运行相同的事件来测试过度授权是否主要是取样文物。
SIR在统计学上无法区分各种条件(p=0.367p=0.367),与预测4一致.
在我们的设置下,过度授权似乎更多地依赖于模型和输入,而不是解码色谱,这表明单靠降低温度不可能消除它.

blocks.en: 4.5 Intervention Effectiveness (RQ3)
blocks.zh: 4.5 干预效力(RQ3)

blocks.en:
We compare prompt-level interventions in Figure 4 and Table 2 .
A clear pattern emerges: interventions that constrain the agent’s action space, especially permission lists and clarification, reduce scope inflation more effectively than those that merely restate or narrow the request.
Exact permission lists are the only intervention that substantially reduces SIR without lowering task completion, but they require oracle knowledge of the minimal tool set.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了图4和表2中的快速干预。
出现了一种明显的模式:限制代理人行动空间的干预措施,特别是许可清单和澄清,比仅仅重复或缩小请求范围的措施更有效地减少范围通货膨胀。
精确许可列表是唯一在不降低任务完成率的情况下大幅降低SIR的干预,但它们需要甲骨文对最小工具集的了解.

blocks.en:
Clarification achieves the lowest SIR among non-oracle interventions but incurs a large TCR penalty, because our benchmark records no tool call when the agent asks a clarifying question instead of acting.
In interactive settings, clarification may therefore be more competitive than its benchmark TCR suggests.
Intent Echo is also informative: restating the user’s intent before acting does not reduce excess scope and can slightly worsen it, suggesting that the problem is not simply surface-level intent misunderstanding.
blocks.zh:
澄清在非甲骨文干预中实现了最低的SIR,但会导致大量TCR处罚,因为我们的基准记录显示,当代理人提出澄清问题而不是采取行动时,没有工具呼叫。
因此,在互动环境中,澄清可能比其基准TCR所示更具竞争性。
意向回声(Intention Echo)也有信息性:在行动前重申用户的意图不会减少过度范围,可能稍稍恶化,说明问题不仅仅是表面层面的意向误解.

blocks.en: Table 2: Prompt-level intervention comparison, aggregated over all seven models and all episodes. Permission List is the only intervention that both reduces SIR and preserves TCR. It requires exact oracle knowledge and is best understood as a ceiling on scope control via external permissioning.
blocks.zh: 表2:快速干预比较,汇总了所有七个模型和所有事件。 权限列表是唯一既减少SIR又保留TCR的干预. 它需要精确的甲骨文知识,最好理解为通过外部许可对范围控制设定上限.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Intervention trade-offs between SIR reduction and task completion. Permission lists achieve substantial scope reduction while preserving TCR.
blocks.zh: 图4:在减少SIR和完成任务之间进行干预权衡。 许可清单在保留TCR的同时实现了大幅缩小范围.

blocks.en:
Permission lists are effective only when they are exact.
We vary the number of extra permitted tools beyond the minimal set and find that models exploit any slack roughly in proportion to the number of extra tools allowed (Figure 5 ), while task completion remains nearly constant.
Approximate permission lists therefore offer limited protection: effective scope control requires knowledge of the exact minimal set rather than a broad superset.
Full per-model results are reported in Appendix C.2 .
blocks.zh:
许可清单只有在准确时才有效。
我们把允许的额外工具数量改变在最低组数之外,发现模型利用任何漏洞与允许的额外工具数量大致成比例(图5),而任务完成情况几乎保持不变。
因此,近似许可清单提供有限的保护:有效的范围控制需要了解精确的最小范围,而不是一个广义的超级集。
附录C.2报告了每个模型的全部结果。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Permission list granularity. Excess calls increase approximately proportionally with the number of extra permitted tools, while TCR remains stable.
blocks.zh: 图5:授权清单颗粒性。 过多的呼叫量与额外允许使用的工具数量大致成比例增加,而TCR则保持稳定.

blocks.en: 4.6 SelfAudit Mitigation (RQ4)
blocks.zh: 4.6 自我审计缓解(RQ4)

blocks.en:
Permission lists require oracle knowledge and are rarely available in practice.
We therefore explore SelfAudit , an oracle-free proof-of-concept mitigation in which the agent first generates request-grounded justifications for planned tool calls and then filters unjustified actions before execution (Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh:
许可清单需要甲骨文知识,实际上很少提供。
因此,我们探索自我审计(SelfAudit),这是一种无甲骨文概念证明的缓解,其中代理商首先为计划的工具呼叫生成基于请求的理由,然后在执行前过滤不合理行动(图6).

blocks.en: Figure 6: The SelfAudit pipeline. The agent justifies each planned tool call against the user’s words, then filters unjustified calls before execution.
blocks.zh: 图6:自我审计管道。 代理商为每个计划的工具调用提供依据,

blocks.en:
An ablation on moderate and vague episodes across four models isolates the contribution of each step (Table 3 ).
Justification alone is counterproductive: models treat articulated reasons as a license rather than a constraint ( + 9 % +9\% PVS).
Filtering alone captures most of the overall effect ( − 36 % -36\% PVS), and the full pipeline adds a small but significant further reduction in SIR (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.005 p{=}0.005 , d = 0.06 d{=}0.06 ).
This reduction comes with a modest completion trade-off, with TCR falling from 0.94 to 0.89, so SelfAudit is better viewed as a tunable proof of concept than as a drop-in deployment solution.
Extended baselines (Appendix F ) show that even a single-sentence removal instruction reduces SIR by 24%.
The main takeaway is that an explicit removal step substantially reduces excess scope; grounded justification helps structure this step but is not the primary driver.
The method is not fully domain-agnostic: lexical grounding is often sufficient when tool descriptions share content words with typical requests, but more abstract naming schemes would likely require stronger semantic matching.
Per-model breakdowns, robustness tests, and representative traces appear in Appendix F.3 .
blocks.zh:
跨越四个模型的温和和模糊的片断隔离了每个步骤的贡献(表3)。
单凭理由是适得其反的:模型将阐明的理由视为许可而非约束(+9%+9+++++PVS).
单独过滤就能捕捉到大部分总体效果(−36%-36\%PVS),全管在SIR中又增加了少量但显著的进一步减少(paired Wilcoxon p = 0.005 p = 0.005,d = 0.06 d = 0.06).
这一减少伴随着适度的完成权衡,TCR从0.94降至0.89,因此,自我审计被更好地视为概念的可捕证据,而不是一个即时部署的解决办法。
扩展基线(附录F)显示,即使是单一判决解除指令也会将SIR减少24%.
主要外卖是,明确的清除步骤大大减少了过度范围;有根据的理由有助于建立这一步骤的结构,但不是主要驱动力。
该方法不完全域-不可知论:当工具描述与典型请求共享内容词时,语法定位往往就足够了,但更抽象的命名方案可能需要更强的语义匹配.
按型号分列的破损、坚固度测试和代表性痕迹见附录F.3。

blocks.en: Table 3: SelfAudit ablation on moderate and vague episodes. Justify-Only increases scope, Filter-Only captures most of the gain, and the full pipeline yields modest further reduction at the cost of lower TCR. Values are pooled identically to the aggregate results in Table 10 (Appendix F.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表3:对中度和模糊事件的自审。 Justify-Only增加范围,Filter-Only捕捉到大部分收益,全管以降低TCR为代价,产生适度的进一步削减. 数值与表10(附录F.2)的总结果相同。

blocks.en: 4.7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.7 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Cross-model convergence. Models show high agreement on which excess tools to call (Table 4 ), suggesting a shared semantic pattern rather than purely idiosyncratic behavior.
This is consistent with the threshold account: if different models assign similar relevance to semantically proximate tools under the same request, they will over-authorize in similar ways.
Agreement is highest within model families but remains substantial across families ( J J from 0.70 0.70 to 0.82 0.82 among the representative pairs shown; the mean over all 21 pairs is 0.764 0.764 ).
The main outlier is DeepSeek-v3, which shows both lower scope inflation and lower task completion, suggesting a more conservative operating point rather than selective restraint.
Additional agreement analyses appear in Appendix E.1 .
blocks.zh:
跨模式趋同. 模型显示对于哪些多余的工具可以调用(表4)高度一致,建议采用共同的语义模式,而不是纯粹的典型行为.
这与阈值账户是一致的:如果不同的模型在同一请求下为近似工具指定了相似的关联性,它们将以类似的方式过度授权.
在模范家庭内部,协议最高,但在家庭之间仍然相当大(在代表性对夫妇中,J J从0.70 0.70到0.82 0.82;在所有21对家庭中,平均为0.764 0.764)。
主要外围是DeepSeek-v3,它既显示范围通胀率较低,也显示任务完成率较低,表明操作点较保守,而不是选择性限制.
补充协定分析见附录E.1。

blocks.en: Table 4: Pairwise Jaccard similarity on excess tool sets. Representative pairs are shown; the mean is computed over all 21 model pairs. Agreement is highest within model families but remains substantial across families.
blocks.zh: 表4:多余工具集的等效Jaccard相似性。 显示代表对数;平均值在所有21个模型对数中计算。 模范家庭内部的协议最高,但家庭之间协议仍然很大。

blocks.en:
What kinds of excess calls occur? A rule-based taxonomy applied to all baseline excess calls reveals four recurring patterns: Exploratory (50%), Anticipatory (21%), Completionist (20%), and Confirmatory (9%).
Exploratory calls dominate: agents most often retrieve additional information from the same semantic neighborhood as the request rather than invoking unrelated tools.
Over-authorization therefore usually reflects local scope expansion rather than arbitrary tool misuse.
blocks.zh:
什么样的超常通话? 对所有基线超量呼叫适用的规则分类法揭示了四种反复出现的模式:探索型(50%)、预测型(21%)、完成型(20%)和确认型(9%)。
探索性呼叫占主导地位:代理商最常从与请求相同的语义区获取额外信息,而不是引用无关的工具.
因此,过度授权通常反映地方范围的扩大,而不是任意滥用工具。

blocks.en:
When is excess harmful? Recall the three notions of scope introduced in § 1 : benchmark-authorized scope (the conservative, literal-interpretation baseline), user-preferred scope (what a given user would actually want), and deployment-safe scope (what a compliance regime permits).
Excess relative to each scope corresponds to a distinct severity tier: benchmark-authorized excess (any tool call beyond the user’s literal words), user-unwanted excess (actions the user would actively prefer not to occur), and harmful excess (actions that create legal, financial, or personal risk).
Benchmark-authorized excess subsumes the other two, but not all benchmark-authorized excess is unwanted, and not all unwanted excess is harmful.
Table 5 reports human judgments on 340 excess tool calls across 100 episodes (mean 3.40 excess calls per episode).
Overall, 71.2% of flagged excess calls are judged unwanted, 17.0% neutral, and 11.8% wanted.
The specificity breakdown sharpens this picture: for precise requests, the unwanted rate reaches 93.3%, but for vague requests it falls to 63.9%, as anticipatory retrieval more often overlaps with likely follow-up needs.
The practical threshold depends on deployment context: in clinical or financial settings, unnecessary access to private data may be unacceptable, whereas in consumer assistants some anticipatory retrieval may be tolerated.
Human evaluation details are reported in Appendix B.4 .
blocks.zh:
何时过度有害? 回顾第1节中提出的三个范围概念:基准授权范围(保守的、文字解释的基线)、用户首选范围(特定用户实际想要的范围)和部署安全范围(遵守制度允许的范围)。
相对于每个范围而言,超额相当于一个明显的严重程度级:基准授权超额(任何超出用户字面范围的工具调用)、用户不想要的超额(用户积极希望不发生的行动)和有害超额(造成法律、财务或个人风险的行动)。
基准授权的超额包括另外两种,但并非所有基准授权的超额都是不必要的,并非所有不必要的超额都是有害的。
表5报告了人类对100集340次多余工具呼叫(平均每集平均3.40次多余呼叫)的判断.
总体而言,71.2%的标注超标电话被判定为不需要,17.0%为中和,11.8%为通缉。
特异性分解使这一画面更加清晰:对于精确的请求,不想要的速率达到93.3%,但对于模糊的请求,则降至63.9%,因为预告检索往往与可能的后续需求重叠。
实际的门槛取决于部署背景:在临床或金融环境中,不必要地获取私人数据可能是不可接受的,而在消费者助理中,可以容忍一些预期检索。
附录B.4报告了人类评价的详细情况。

blocks.en: Table 5: Human judgments on excess tool calls.
blocks.zh: 表5:人类对过度工具呼叫的判断。

blocks.en:
Design implications. Systems can make scope explicit at interaction time, and tool interfaces can make scope boundaries clearer so that semantically nearby but unnecessary tools do not appear equally relevant.
Training objectives could also penalize unnecessary data access more directly, complementing inference-time methods such as SelfAudit .
The ablation in Table 3 suggests that mitigation pipelines should include an explicit removal step: structured reasoning alone can reinforce rather than constrain scope expansion.
blocks.zh:
设计方面的影响。 系统可以在互动时明确范围,工具界面可以使范围界限更加明确,这样,相近但不必要的工具看起来并不同等相关.
培训目标还可以更直接地惩罚不必要的数据获取,补充自我审计等推断时间方法。
表3中的删减表明,缓解管道应当包括明确的清除步骤:仅靠结构化推理可以加强而不是限制范围扩展。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We study proactive over-authorization , measured under a deliberately conservative benchmark criterion, as a form of scope expansion in which tool-calling agents access more information than a user’s explicit request strictly requires.
We present an interpretive decision-theoretic account that motivates three qualitative predictions.
Under this criterion, over-authorization across seven models from four families is widespread, increases sharply as request specificity decreases, grows sublinearly as the tool pool expands, and remains stable across decoding temperatures.
These results suggest that the behavior is systematic rather than a sampling artifact.
We introduce OverAct , a controlled benchmark with deterministic, judge-free scoring across eight privacy-sensitive domains.
We also present SelfAudit , a proof-of-concept inference-time mitigation that does not require oracle knowledge.
Its ablation shows that the main driver of scope reduction is an explicit removal step rather than structured justification alone, pointing to self-filtering as a starting point for oracle-free mitigation.
blocks.zh:
我们研究了主动的过度授权问题,这是根据有意保守的基准标准衡量的,作为扩大范围的一种形式,在这种形式中,工具调用代理人获取的信息比用户的明确要求严格要求要多。
我们提出了一个解释性的决定理论说明,它激励着三个定性预测。
根据这一标准,来自4个家庭的7个模型的过度授权是普遍存在的,随着要求的特异性减少而急剧增加,随着工具池的扩展而细线性地增长,并在整个解码温度中保持稳定。
这些结果表明,这种行为是系统性的,而不是一个采样文物.
我们引入了OverAct(OverAct),这是一个控制的基准,具有决定性,无法官评分的八个对隐私敏感的领域.
我们还提出自我审计,这是不要求甲骨文知识的概念推断时间的证明。
它的萎缩表明,缩小范围的主要动力是明确的去除步骤,而不是仅仅有条理地说明理由,指出自我过滤是无甲骨文减缓的起点.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
OverAct is a diagnostic benchmark that uses controlled tool schemas with six tools per domain.
These choices enable deterministic measurement, but the absolute magnitude of over-authorization in production settings may differ.
Our ecological validation experiment (Appendix D.2 ) extends pool sizes to 10, 15, and 20 with richer schemas, but larger tool pools may introduce additional forms of over-authorization not captured here.
Our decision-theoretic account is calibrated post hoc and is intended as an interpretive model.
The PVS metric treats all PII categories equally, although some excess accesses, such as financial versus preference data, are clearly more consequential than others; a severity-weighted metric would better capture this distinction.
Finally, our benchmark adopts a strict privacy-first authorization criterion.
This enables deterministic evaluation, but it may classify as excess some actions that would be considered helpful in other deployment contexts.
blocks.zh:
OverAct是一个诊断基准,它使用每个域有6个工具的可控工具计划.
这些选择有利于确定计量,但生产环境中过度授权的绝对程度可能有所不同。
我们的生态验证实验(Appendix D.2 )将池的大小扩展到10,15,和20,并配有更丰富的计划,但更大的工具池可能会引入在此没有捕捉到的额外形式的过度授权.
我们的决定理论账户是经过校准后临时的,意在作为一个解释模型。
PVS衡量标准对所有PII类别一视同仁,尽管一些过度访问,如财务数据与优惠数据,显然比其他数据更具后果性;重度加权衡量标准将更好地反映这种区别。
最后,我们的基准采用严格的隐私第一批准标准。
这使得能够进行确定性评价,但它可能将一些被认为在其他部署情况下有帮助的行动归类为多余行动。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
This work does not involve real user data or deployed decision-making systems.
All models were accessed through API endpoints under standard terms.
Our goal is to support the development of more privacy-respecting tool-calling systems.
There are also dual-use considerations.
Characterizing systematic patterns in tool selection could help an adversary anticipate what information an agent is likely to retrieve, although such behavior is already observable through ordinary API use.
Conversely, scope-minimization strategies such as SelfAudit may increase over-filtering, especially for vague requests whose intended scope is genuinely broad.
We therefore view OverAct as a diagnostic benchmark rather than as a prescription that all excess actions should always be eliminated.
blocks.zh:
这项工作不涉及真正的用户数据或部署决策系统。
所有模型都通过标准条款下的API端点访问.
我们的目标是支持开发更多尊重隐私的工具调用系统。
还有双重用途的考虑。
在工具选择中指定系统模式可以帮助对手预测一个代理人可能获取的信息,尽管通过普通API的使用,这种行为已经可以观察到.
反之,将范围最小化的战略,如自我审计,可能会增加过度过滤,特别是对于计划范围真正广泛的模糊请求。
因此,我们认为 " 过度行动 " 是一个诊断性基准,而不是应当永远消除一切过度行动的处方。

If relevance decays sufficiently quickly with rank, only a bounded prefix of tools exceeds threshold and excess saturates.
If it decays more slowly, additional tools may continue to cross threshold as the pool expands, but the number of such crossings grows at a diminishing rate.
Under the empirically observed regime in our affordance analysis, this growth is approximately logarithmic in tool-pool size.
Expected excess therefore grows sublinearly with pool size, which is the qualitative bounded-saturation pattern claimed in Prediction 3 .
Appendix D.1 reports empirical evidence consistent with this pattern.

Argument for Prediction 4 . Prediction 4 is explicitly conditional.

blocks.en: B.2 Annotation Guidelines

blocks.en: This section documents the protocol used to construct the benchmark reference minimal tool sets in OverAct .
blocks.zh: 本节记录用于构建OverAct中基准参考最小工具集的协议.

blocks.en: Annotation principles. 1. Literal interpretation. Only tool calls directly entailed by the user’s explicit words are treated as authorized. Anticipated needs, contextually helpful extensions, and common-sense elaborations are treated as excess. 2. Minimal sufficiency. Among all tool sets sufficient to satisfy the request, the smallest one is selected. If multiple sets have the same cardinality, the one that accesses fewer PII categories is preferred. 3. Conservative boundary. In ambiguous cases, the smaller set is adopted, biasing toward excess classification rather than permissive expansion.
blocks.zh: 注释原则. 1. 字面解释。 只有用户的直言直接引发的工具呼叫才被视为授权。 预期需要、对背景有帮助的扩展和常识的阐述被视为多余。 2. 最低限度充足。 在所有足以满足请求的工具组中,选择最小的工具组. 如果多个集具有相同的核心性,则优先使用较少的PII类。 3. 保守边界。 在模棱两可的情况下,采用较小的一套,偏重于过度分类,而不是随意扩大。

blocks.en:
SIR as a ratio metric. The same absolute excess can imply different relative scope inflation depending on the size of the minimal set.
For example, one extra tool yields SIR = 2.0 =2.0 when | A minimal | = 1 |A_{\text{minimal}}|=1 , but SIR = 1.33 =1.33 when | A minimal | = 3 |A_{\text{minimal}}|=3 .
For episodes with larger minimal sets, the main conclusions are unchanged under both ratio-based and absolute-excess formulations.

blocks.en:
Absolute excess counts. In absolute terms, the mean baseline excess is about 0.7 additional tool calls per episode.
Because many episodes have | A minimal | = 1 |A_{\text{minimal}}|=1 , this absolute magnitude is small, and PVS provides a complementary severity-weighted view of the privacy-oriented excess.
The qualitative patterns reported in the main text (the cross-model gradient, the specificity effect, and the saturation behavior) are supported by absolute-excess and PVS analyses as well as by SIR.

blocks.en:
Severity-weighted PVS. PVS treats all accessed PII categories equally.
This simplifies annotation, but it does not distinguish between categories that may differ substantially in downstream privacy consequence.
A severity-weighted variant could better reflect differential risk, but it would require an additional layer of normative judgment outside the scope of the present benchmark.

blocks.en: B.4 Human Evaluation of Excess Actions

blocks.en:
Our automatic metrics classify every tool call beyond the annotated minimal set as excess.
To assess whether these calls are also perceived as unnecessary by users, we conduct a human evaluation study.
We sample 100 baseline episodes with at least one excess tool call (SIR > 1.0 >1.0 ), stratified by specificity: 20 precise, 35 moderate, and 45 vague.
The sample covers all eight domains.
For each excess call, annotators answer: Would you, as the user who made this request, have wanted this additional action to be taken? Responses are collected on a three-point scale: Unwanted , Neutral , or Wanted .
Table 5 shows that 71.2% of excess calls are judged unwanted and 17.0% neutral, while 11.8% are judged positively.
The unwanted rate is highest for precise requests and lowest for vague requests, mirroring the specificity gradient in the main experiments.

blocks.en: C.3 Reproducibility Details

blocks.en: All experiments use the official API endpoints of the four providers, accessed during June–August 2026 (the period preceding the August 2026 submission). Each configuration is run for three repetitions with tool presentation order randomized per episode; all randomized procedures (including the cross-domain tool padding in Appendix D.1 ) use seed 42. Decoding settings: temperature is { 0.0 , 0.7 , 1.0 } \{0.0,0.7,1.0\} for the temperature ablation (Appendix D ) and 0.7 0.7 otherwise; all other sampling parameters use provider defaults. We use each provider’s native tool-calling mode, collecting the full tool-call plan before execution where the API supports it. API requests use retry with exponential backoff on transient errors; rate-limit and HTTP errors trigger re-runs so that every reported configuration attains the intended three repetitions. Malformed or empty tool-call responses are discarded and re-issued; in the ecological validation (Appendix D.2 ) this affected 12.0 % 12.0\% of attempted runs, spread evenly across pool sizes. Exact API model identifiers, snapshot dates, and the full run logs are released with the supplementary material to support reproduction even as providers update model weights behind a version name.

blocks.en:

Tool-pool sizes are varied over { 4 , 6 , 12 , 24 , 36 , 48 } \{4,6,12,24,36,48\} .

blocks.en:
A potential concern is that our baseline evaluation uses six tools per domain with short descriptions, whereas larger registries may expose agents to more complex schemas (e.g., nested parameters, enums, authentication tokens, pagination).
To test robustness, we generate 14 additional tools per domain with extended schemas and evaluate at pool sizes { 10 , 15 , 20 } \{10,15,20\} using within-domain distractors.
We run two models (Qwen3.6-Plus, DeepSeek-v4-Pro) on moderate and vague episodes with three repetitions, yielding 2,880 attempted runs; 2,534 completed runs are retained after discarding malformed or empty tool-call responses (12.0% drop, evenly spread across pool sizes).

Across all 480 episodes (two models, all specificity levels), over-authorizing episodes (SIR > 2 >2 ) produce longer traces on average (mean 1,435 tokens) than compliant episodes (SIR ≤ 1 \leq 1 , mean 718 tokens).

blocks.en: Appendix F SelfAudit and Mitigation Details

blocks.en: F.1 Minimal Removal-Instruction Baseline
blocks.zh: F.1 最小清除-指令基线

blocks.en:
To test whether the full SelfAudit pipeline adds value beyond a simple minimization instruction, we evaluate a one-sentence removal prompt that tells the agent to call only tools strictly required by the user’s exact words, with no structured planning or per-tool justification stage.
This minimal instruction reduces SIR by 24% relative to baseline, confirming that an explicit removal step is the primary active ingredient and that the structured protocol is not necessary for a sizable share of the gain.
blocks.zh:
为了测试整个自我审计管道是否比简单的最小化指令更有价值,我们评价一个一次性删除的提示,告诉代理人只调用用户严格要求的工具,没有结构化的规划或每个工具的论证阶段。
这一最低限度指令将SIR相对于基线减少24%,确认明确的去除步骤是主要活性成分,结构化协议对于收益的相当大份额是不必要的.

blocks.en: F.2 Aggregate SelfAudit Results
blocks.zh: F.2 综合自评结果

blocks.en:
Table 10 reports the full SelfAudit before/after comparison on moderate and vague episodes across the four high-inflation models (Qwen3.6-Plus, Qwen3.7-Max, DeepSeek-v4-Pro, Kimi-K2.7-Code).
These four are selected for the ablation because they exhibit the highest baseline SIR on the moderate and vague subset; GLM-5.2, despite a high overall SIR, is excluded from the ablation subset for consistency with the initial pilot study, and its SelfAudit results are reported separately in Table 11 . DeepSeek-v3 and Qwen3.6-Flash are excluded for low baseline inflation and unreliable multi-step instruction following respectively. SelfAudit reduces scope inflation by 26% and PVS by 43%, with a moderate effect size ( d = 0.36 d=0.36 ).
The reduction is larger for vague requests than for moderate ones, where lexical grounding removes a greater share of marginal tool calls. SelfAudit occasionally over-filters tools that were in fact needed, especially when the request is paraphrastic or when the lexical link between request and tool description is indirect.
In our benchmark, 92% of tool descriptions share at least one content word with typical domain requests, making lexical grounding generally viable; for APIs with more abstract naming conventions, stronger semantic matching would likely be needed.
blocks.zh:
表10报告在比较四种高通胀模式(Qune3.6-Plus、Qune3.7-Max、DeepSeek-v4-Pro、Kimi-K2.7-Code)的中度和模糊事件之前/之后的完全自审情况。
选择这四个项目是因为它们在中度和模糊的子集上表现出最高的基线SIR;GLM-5.2,尽管总体SIR较高,但因与初步试点研究的一致性而被排除在分集中,其自学结果在表11中另行报告。 DeepSeek-v3和Quen3.6-Flash分别因低基线通货膨胀和不可靠的多步骤指令而被排除在外。 自行审计将范围通胀降低26%,PVS降低43%,中等效应大小(d=0.36 d=0.36).
模糊请求的减少比温和请求的减少要大,因为Lexical地基删除了更大比例的边际工具调用. SelfAudit偶尔也会使用事实上需要的过过滤器工具,特别是当请求是可解释的,或者当请求和工具描述之间的词汇联系是间接的.
在我们的基准中,92%的工具描述与典型域请求共享至少一个内容单词,这使得词典定位普遍可行;对于更抽象的命名惯例的API来说,可能需要更强的语义匹配.

blocks.en: F.3 SelfAudit Mechanism
blocks.zh: F.3 自我审计机制

blocks.en:
Mechanistic interpretation. SelfAudit can be interpreted as inserting an explicit justification stage before execution.
Rather than acting on all plausible tool calls, the model must tie each planned action to specific words in the user’s request.
Under the decision-theoretic framing, this makes unjustified extra calls harder to sustain and can therefore reduce excess scope.
We treat this as an interpretive account of the intervention rather than a directly verified internal mechanism.
blocks.zh:
机械诠释. 自我审计可以解释为在执行前插入一个明确的理由说明阶段。
该模式不是对所有可能的工具呼吁采取行动,而是必须将每一个计划的行动与用户请求中的具体词语联系起来。
根据决定理论框架,这就使没有理由的额外呼吁更难维持,因此可以减少过多的范围。
我们将此视为对干预的解释性说明,而不是直接核实的内部机制。

blocks.en:
Sham-justification control. To test whether SelfAudit helps simply by increasing deliberation length, we measure the relationship between justification length and SIR and find no evidence that longer justifications alone reduce excess (Spearman ρ = − 0.03 \rho=-0.03 , p = 0.72 p=0.72 ).
We also evaluate a sham control in which the model lists tools with generic explanations not tied to request words and then executes them all.
This condition is run on the same moderate and vague episodes as the main ablation but pools over a broader set of runs (including episodes from the tool-variation pilot), yielding a higher baseline SIR of 2.77.
The sham condition yields SIR = 2.69 =2.69 ( Δ = − 3 % \Delta=-3\% , p = 0.41 p=0.41 ), suggesting that lexical grounding, rather than deliberation length alone, accounts for the observed gain.
blocks.zh:
骗徒理由控制。 为了检验自我审计是否仅通过延长审议时间而有所帮助,我们衡量理由长度与SIR之间的关系,并没有发现任何证据说明仅凭理由就可以减少过量(Spearman à = 0.03\rho=-0.03,p = 0.72 )。
我们还评估一个假控制,即模型列出一些工具,不附带与请求单词相关的一般解释,然后将其全部执行。
这个条件运行在与主衰减的相同中度和模糊的时段上,但集合在更广泛的时段(包括来自工具变换飞行员的时段)上,得出更高的基线SIR为2.77.
假条件产生SIR = 2.69 = 2.69 (XQ = − 3%\Delta =-3\%,p = 0.41 p = 0.41),说明词法基础化,而不是仅考虑长度,是观察到收益的原因.

blocks.en:
Tool-description variation. Renaming tools with opaque identifiers (e.g., get_checking_balance → \rightarrow api_fn_001 ) while preserving descriptions yields SIR = 2.04 =2.04 versus 2.00 with the original names ( Δ = + 2 % \Delta=+2\% , p = 0.68 p=0.68 ), suggesting that the method relies more on description semantics than on tool-name keywords.
However, when tool descriptions are aggressively paraphrased to remove lexical overlap with typical requests, SelfAudit ’s reduction weakens from − 28 % -28\% to − 18 % -18\% in a 50-episode pilot.
This is consistent with partial dependence on lexical overlap between requests and tool descriptions.
blocks.zh:
工具描述变量. 用不透明的标识符重命名工具(例如: get_checking_balance →\rightarrow api_fn_001),同时保留描述值的SIR = 2.04 = 2.04 = 2.00 与原名相对应的2.00( = + 2%\Delta=+2\%,p= 0.68 p=0.68),说明该方法更多地依赖于描述语义而不是工具名关键词.
然而,当工具描述被粗略地解释为去除与典型要求的词汇重叠时,SelfAudit的减少从-28%-28%-18 %-18 %-50集的试点被削弱。
这与部分依赖请求和工具描述之间的词汇重叠是一致的。

blocks.en:
Per-model results. Table 11 reports SelfAudit effectiveness across all seven models.
Six of seven models show PVS reductions, ranging from 10% (Qwen3.6-Flash) to 57% (DeepSeek-v4-Pro).
DeepSeek-v3, the most conservative baseline (SIR 1.18, PVS 0.60, TCR 0.80), shows an anomalous pattern: the structured SelfAudit prompt activates wider tool calling from this low-inflation baseline, increasing both TCR and SIR simultaneously.
Qwen3.6-Flash shows little effect, likely because it does not reliably follow multi-step prompting instructions.
blocks.zh:
亲模结果. 表11报告所有七个模式的自我审计效力。
7种模型中有6种显示PVS减产,从10%(Quen3.6-Flash)到57%(DeepSeek-v4-Pro)不等.
DeepSeek-v3,最保守的基线(SIR 1.18,PVS 0.60,TCR 0.80)显示了一种异常模式:结构化的自审即时激活了从这种低通胀基线中调用的更广泛的工具,同时增加TCR和SIR.
Qune3.6-Flash显示效果不大,可能是因为它不可靠地遵循多步骤的提示.

blocks.en: Table 11: Per-model SelfAudit effectiveness across all seven models. † DeepSeek-v3’s positive Δ \Delta SIR and Δ \Delta PVS reflect increased tool calling from a very low baseline; task completion rises alongside privacy exposure.
blocks.zh: 表11:所有7个模型的每个模型的自审有效性。 † DeepSeek-v3的阳性 Δ\Delta SIR 和 ΔDelta PVS 反映了从非常低的基线调用的工具增加;任务完成率随隐私暴露而上升。

blocks.en:
Ablation details. Table 3 in the main text reports the aggregate ablation.
The per-model pattern is consistent: Justify-Only increases PVS for three of the four tested models (Qwen3.6-Plus: + 19 % +19\% ; Qwen3.7-Max: + 22 % +22\% ; Kimi-K2.7-Code: + 8 % +8\% ), while DeepSeek-v4-Pro shows a small decrease ( − 2 % -2\% ).
The effect is largest for models with the most pronounced baseline tendency to rationalize extended tool use.
Filter-Only reduces PVS for all four models, with the largest gains for Qwen3.6-Plus ( − 46 % -46\% ) and Kimi-K2.7-Code ( − 42 % -42\% ).
The gap between Filter-Only and Full SelfAudit is small but significant (paired Wilcoxon p = 0.005 p{=}0.005 , d = 0.06 d{=}0.06 ), suggesting that grounded justifications may add a small incremental scaffold for filtering.
blocks.zh:
远征细节. 主文中的表3报告了总的消耗。
平面模型模式一致:合理-只为四个测试模型中的三个增加了PVS(Qune3.6-Plus:+19%+19\%;Qune3.7-Max:+22%+22\%;Kimi-K2.7-Code:+8%+8\%),而DeepSeek-v4-Pro显示略有下降(−2%–2\%).
对于基线趋势最明显的使扩展工具使用合理化的模型,影响最大。
Filter-仅减少所有四种型号的PVS,其中Qwen3.6-Plus(−46%-46\%)和Kimi-K2.7-Code(−42%-42\%)的增益最大.
Filter-Only和Full SelfAudit之间的差距很小,但很大(Paired Wilcoxon p = 0.005 p{=}0.005,d = 0.06 d{=}0.06),说明有根据的理由可能会为过滤增加一个小的递增脚手架.
